name: com.m320.state-machine-system
description: A framework for implementing state-driven behaviours.

samples.description: Contains a TimedCore for handling an idle and a timed state. Click the 'Time' button to enter the 'Timed' state, afterwards, it enters the 'Idle'.
Contains a PlayerCore for handling player movement. Use the 'A' & 'D' to move around horizontally, and 'Space' to jump.
Contains an AICore for handling AI behaviour. 'Press' & 'Hold' to attract targets (white balls). The AI will chase the closest target within it's line of sight, otherwise, wonder around.
